title: Scouting at the Florida Dental Convention
html:
Michelle Knebelsberger (CDS MWM 2029 Program Chair) and her husband Doug traveled to Orlando, Florida in June to attend the Florida Dental Convention along with Renee Pappas (CDS VP), Mike Durbin and our CDS President Phil Schefke and his wife Sandy Tableriou. They spent 3 days there scouting potential future speakers for our Chicago MWM.
